clue.text: Henry left guild in the lurch-charming

indicators.note: lurching suggests a sudden stagger, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Henry has walked out on his trade guild, abandoning it charmingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like the abbreviation L but is used whole; 'in the lurch' signals that H, LEFT and GUILD are jumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something delightful gives great pleasure, which is what a charming thing does.

clue.text: Take off direct increase

parts.note: to direct something somewhere is to send it
up as in prices going up, an increase

explanation.surface: An instruction to remove a direct rise, perhaps in a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A take-off is a parody or mimicking impression, the same thing as a satirical send-up.

clue.text: A number accompanying the German marshal getting to island

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a number
der is a German word for 'the'
Michel Ney was one of Napoleon's marshals

explanation.surface: A number of troops travel with a German marshal on his way to an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting to' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Alderney is one of the Channel Islands, lying off the coast of Normandy.

clue.text: Majority of new sale items turned up, having fallen off lorry

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
most of the word, so the final letter of new is dropped

parts.note: lots are items offered at an auction sale

explanation.surface: Most of the new auction lots have reappeared, and it seems they were pinched from a lorry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses NE plus LOTS, giving STOLEN. 'Fallen off the back of a lorry' is British slang for stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods said to have fallen off a lorry are, in British slang, thieved.

clue.text: Way to get solar heating

parts.note: reads like a home energy system, but means a person warming up by lying out under the sun

explanation.surface: A tip on installing a solar-powered heating system.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying in the sun is a way for your body to be heated by solar rays.

clue.text: Upset greedy operatic star

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: avid means eager or greedy

explanation.surface: A grasping opera singer throws a tantrum.
explanation.definitionFit: A prima donna, the leading female singer in an opera.

clue.text: Told to pick up present

indicators.note: told means spoken, signalling the word is to be said out loud

parts.note: to pick up a sound is to hear it

explanation.surface: Someone instructed to collect a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: Present as in in attendance, as when answering a roll call.

clue.text: Dawn chorus?

parts.note: reads as birdsong at sunrise, but dawn is when it gets light and a chorus is a piece of music

explanation.surface: The birds singing at first light.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy-listening tunes; dawn brings daylight and a chorus is something sung, so a playful description.

clue.text: Finger-wagging about a cutting I lose

indicators.note: about signals the letters are moved around into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone wagging a finger in warning over a cutting being lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Gesticulation is making expressive gestures with hands and arms, as wagging a finger does.

clue.text: Guard's reduced-it's stupid

parts.note: to mind is to guard or look after
reduced means made less

explanation.surface: A security guard has been demoted, which seems foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Mindless means without thought or intelligence, hence foolish.

clue.text: Close in to catch retreating North African

indicators.note: in places the word for close inside the other piece
retreating means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them
by means near or close at hand

explanation.surface: Moving in to grab a North African who is falling back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Close' looks like a verb but is the adverb, near at hand; 'in' is the container signal and 'retreating' the reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Libyan is a native of Libya, a country of North Africa.

clue.text: Order work by popular composer

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order
op. is short for opus, a musical work
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Commissioning a piece from a well-liked composer.
explanation.walkthrough: The Order of the Companions of Honour (CH) is a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Frédéric Chopin was the Polish Romantic composer of piano music.

clue.text: Very quickly, I mention getting upset

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone who quickly gets upset at the slightest mention.
explanation.definitionFit: In no time is an idiom for at great speed or almost immediately.

clue.text: Girl grabbing one lot -it could be an accident

indicators.note: grabbing means seizing, so the girl's letters close around one

parts.note: Ms is a title for a woman or girl
I is the Roman numeral one
one's lot is one's fate or fortune

explanation.surface: A girl snatching a lot at an auction, which might be accidental.
explanation.definitionFit: A misfortune is a stroke of bad luck, and an accident is one example.

clue.text: Joke shop's done for deception

definitions.meaning: a shop selling jokes is literally a comic trade

explanation.surface: A joke shop is set up as a front for fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: 's done for' links the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, a comic trade such as a joke shop; idiomatically, shady or underhand behaviour.

clue.text: Raw recruit?

parts.note: suggests an inexperienced soldier, but raw is used in the sense of unclothed, a new member of a nudist club

explanation.surface: A green new army recruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A nudist goes about in the raw, so a new joiner of a nudist club is a raw recruit.

clue.text: Home set up by expert

parts.note: in means at home
to form something is to set it up

explanation.surface: A house built by a specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Being well informed means knowing a subject thoroughly, like an expert.

clue.text: Large number pack out American vessels

indicators.note: the large number is set in the middle, pushing the letters of pack out on both sides

parts.note: to pack a hall is to fill it
a lot is a large number

explanation.surface: Crowds of Americans cram into ships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pack out' reads as one phrasal verb, meaning to fill a venue; here 'pack' gives the letters and 'out' signals the large number splitting them.
explanation.definitionFit: A flotilla is a small fleet of ships or boats.

clue.text: Greek character and doctor going in Russian car

indicators.note: going in places the doctor inside the car

parts.note: Lada is a Russian make of car
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A Greek and a doctor climb into a Russian car.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Works to contract for agent

indicators.note: contracting means shortening, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: a works is a factory

explanation.surface: Someone at the factory taking on contract work through an agent.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is a business agent who buys and sells on another's behalf.

clue.text: Compelling data found in chapter on scripture texts

indicators.note: found in means placed inside, so the data goes within the other letters

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a body of scriptural texts
gen is slang for information or data

explanation.surface: Persuasive evidence is discovered in a chapter about scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: A cogent argument is convincing and persuasive.

clue.text: Have a bearing on border region of Ireland

parts.note: N, north, is a compass bearing
a trim is an edging or border

explanation.surface: Influence over the borderland of Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Have a bearing on' reads as one idiom, but 'Have' and 'on' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Antrim is a county of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: In Paris we will show common sense

explanation.surface: Parisians will display good sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The French first person plural pronoun; also, from Greek, British slang for good practical sense.

clue.text: I charge round to fix water

indicators.note: round means the charge goes around the other piece

parts.note: a rate is a price or charge
to rig is to fix dishonestly

explanation.surface: I am billing for repairing water.
explanation.definitionFit: To irrigate is to supply land with water.

clue.text: Advance party reaching new church settlement

parts.note: a sub is an advance of money on wages
a side is a party in a dispute or game
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: An advance team arrives at a new church settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Subsidence is the sinking or settling of ground or buildings.

clue.text: One nest containing rare Hawaiian bird

indicators.note: the two words contain the bird, its letters running across them

explanation.surface: A single nest holding an endangered bird from Hawaii.
explanation.definitionFit: The nene is the Hawaiian goose, a threatened species and the state bird.
